introduction: New Mexico unemployment uses the Workforce Solutions online claims system or its phone application route. The initial claim and weekly certifications are separate requirements.
description: New Mexico unemployment uses the Workforce Solutions online claims system or its phone application route. The initial claim and weekly certifications are separate requirements

sections.who: DWS assesses covered earnings, unemployment circumstances and ongoing eligibility. Follow the ability, availability and work-search instructions assigned to your claim.
sections.get: Approved benefits provide temporary financial support. Each weekly certification supplies information needed to assess payment for that week.
sections.docs:
• Identity and Social Security information.
  • Employer contacts, employment dates and separation details.
  • Weekly earnings and hours.
  • Work-search evidence and agency messages.
sections.apply:
1. Apply online or by phone

    Use the DWS system or call 877-664-6984 during the agency’s published weekday hours.

  2. Complete the claim review

    Answer eligibility questions and follow any verification notice. Save confirmations.

  3. Certify each week

    Submit the weekly request and report work, earnings and availability accurately.
sections.after: Check the claim account and correspondence. Keep evidence of work-search activities so it is available for review, and ask DWS about a disputed decision or interruption in filing.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using DWS initial and weekly filing routes, Work-search records and local help, Current online system. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does the initial application request all future payments?
No. The agency requires weekly certification.
The current agency page lists 877-664-6984, weekdays 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
Where can I get job-search support?
DWS links local America’s Job Centers and work-search resources alongside the claims process.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
